evals.prompt: I built a three.js product viewer for a watch (glTF with metal and glass parts). It looks flat and plasticky with a black background. I want it to look like a premium e-commerce render. What should I change? Give me the code for the lighting/rendering setup.
evals.expected_output: Environment lighting (RoomEnvironment via PMREMGenerator or HDRI with HDRLoader + EquirectangularReflectionMapping as scene.environment), tone mapping (Neutral or ACES/AgX) with exposure, sRGB output, soft shadows (VSM or contact shadow / ShadowMaterial ground), glass via MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission/ior/thickness, metal with metalness 1 and roughness map, blurred background (backgroundBlurriness) or gradient, optional bloom on highlights and GTAO; AA via antialias:true. Uses r187 names (HDRLoader, outputColorSpace, no PCFSoftShadowMap).
assertions: Adds environment lighting: PMREMGenerator + RoomEnvironment or HDRI via HDRLoader with EquirectangularReflectionMapping set as scene.environment
Sets tone mapping (ACES/AgX/Neutral) with exposure and keeps outputColorSpace sRGB
Glass via MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission/ior/thickness; metal via metalness 1 + roughness, not opacity hacks
Replaces the black background with a studio look (a light neutral seamless backdrop, a gradient or a blurred environment) and grounds the watch with a soft or contact shadow
Soft shadow or contact shadow on a ground catcher (ShadowMaterial / VSM / radius)
Anti-aliasing that survives the pipeline: antialias: true without a composer, or with EffectComposer a multisampled render target (samples > 0) or an SMAA/FXAA pass
No pre-r187 names (RGBELoader, outputEncoding, GammaCorrectionShader)

Targets r187: any pinned or stated version is three@0.187.x / r187, and no API that r187 deprecates or removed (Clock, renderer.library.addLight, iridescenceThicknessRange, PCFSoftShadowMap, ColorManagement.fromWorkingColorSpace, transformedNormalView, renderAsync)

evals.prompt: Add a cinematic post-processing stack to my three.js WebGLRenderer scene: bloom only on emissive neon signs, ambient occlusion, slight film grain and vignette, and depth of field focused on the character. Keep tone mapping correct.
evals.expected_output: EffectComposer with RenderPass, GTAOPass, UnrealBloomPass (selective via layers/emissive strategy with threshold near 1 or material trick), BokehPass, FilmPass, vignette via ShaderPass or VignetteShader, OutputPass last (tone mapping + sRGB), HalfFloatType render target, composer.setSize on resize and MSAA samples; correct ordering and no GammaCorrectionShader.
assertions: Tone mapping applied exactly once: one OutputPass with only display-space passes (grain, vignette, FXAA) after it, or renderer.setEffects with no OutputPass
Bloom is truly selective: neon meshes isolated via layers / a second composer or an emissive MRT target, not only a global luminance threshold
Adds ambient occlusion (GTAOPass, SAOPass or SSAOPass)
Adds depth of field (BokehPass or equivalent) focused on the character distance
Adds film grain and vignette (FilmPass plus a vignette pass/shader)
Uses an HDR (HalfFloatType) render target or explains why it matters for bloom
Anti-aliasing survives the composer: multisampled render target (samples > 0) or an SMAA/FXAA pass; antialias: true alone does not count

Targets r187: any pinned or stated version is three@0.187.x / r187, and no API that r187 deprecates or removed (Clock, renderer.library.addLight, iridescenceThicknessRange, PCFSoftShadowMap, ColorManagement.fromWorkingColorSpace, transformedNormalView, renderAsync)

evals.prompt: My outdoor three.js scene (terrain 2km wide, trees, a house) has shadows that are blurry blobs near the camera and disappear far away, and the edges of everything shimmer when the camera moves. How do I get crisp stable shadows and clean edges?
evals.expected_output: Cascaded shadow maps (CSM from three/addons/csm/CSM.js or CSMShadowNode on WebGPU) with cascades/maxFar, tight shadow camera, normalBias, mapSize, shadow map type choice; for shimmering: anti-aliasing options (MSAA antialias:true, TAA/TRAA, SMAA/FXAA), texture anisotropy and mipmaps for terrain, specular aliasing mitigation; mentions the cost tradeoffs.
assertions: Uses cascaded shadow maps (CSM addon) or SunLight for a 2km terrain instead of one huge shadow camera
Tunes shadow.bias / normalBias and mapSize with concrete values
Addresses shimmering from shadow texels (stabilized cascades / texel snapping) separately from geometry aliasing
Enables anti-aliasing (antialias: true MSAA, or SMAA/TAA/FXAA pass) for edge shimmer
No PCFSoftShadowMap; uses PCFShadowMap/VSMShadowMap
If WebGPU SunLight is shown, registers it with SunLight.registerNode(SunLightNode), not renderer.library.addLight

Targets r187: any pinned or stated version is three@0.187.x / r187, and no API that r187 deprecates or removed (Clock, renderer.library.addLight, iridescenceThicknessRange, PCFSoftShadowMap, ColorManagement.fromWorkingColorSpace, transformedNormalView, renderAsync)
